Polygons, water-access weights, suitability texture and terrain exclusions are reconstruction assumptions, not an elevation/climate raster, a census, proof of occupation at every point or a claim that all Roma were nomadic. People, chronology and cohort accounting are unchanged.

Ukraine displacement and differing umbrella/census categories remain unresolved. No original source population, ancestry or historical chronology is overwritten.
